body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News & Press Release> Proton introduces the two entries with its new True Acoustic Enhanced Audio Technology — the TA-37 and TA-42 Audio Enhanced High-Definition LCD Televisions at the 2008 International Consumer Electronics Show.

The TA-37 and TA-42 are exceptionally high quality 37- and 42-inch, high-definition, widescreen, flat-panel TVs. They boast brilliantly clear, progressively scanned 1080p Full HD resolution, built-in digital and analog tuners, and multiple HDMI inputs. The movie-style widescreen aspect ratio is augmented by conventional 4:3, 16:9 Zoom, and Panoramic display modes. Dual-picture functions — Picture-in-Picture and Picture-on-Picture — provide alternative ways to watch TV. In addition the TA series features an exclusive audio technology, True Acoustic Enhanced Audio, featuring a pair of 60-watt power speakers for real Hi-Fi audio experience.

The series includes the two 5.25” loudspeakers handling 60 watts and a pair of 2” tweeters. The crossover frequency is at 1000Hz. Both the preamplifier and power amplifier are also built into the TA series. The power amplifier has output of 60 watts, total harmonic and inter-modulation distortion at less then 0.01%, with built-in bass equalization and subsonic filter circuits. To receive a true listening experience Proton is showcasing these phenomenal sets at its booth in South Hall 1, 20613. The stylish sets offer consumers the benefit of a phenomenal visual and audio experience that clearly stands above the rest.
